programme.title: The Jesus Code
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - The True Cross'. This episode investigates the incredible legend of what many considered to be the greatest relic in Christianity, the True Cross, the actual cross Jesus died on.

programme.title: The Jesus Code
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - The Gospel Of Mary Magdalene'. This episode explores the character of Mary Magdalene as she has been viewed in Christian tradition, as well as how she is presented in the pages of the Gospels.

programme.title: The Jesus Code
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - Childhood Home Of Jesus'. Explore the uncovering of a 2,000-year-old house hidden under modern Nazareth, which experts believe could be the childhood home of Jesus.

programme.title: The Jesus Code
programme.desc: 'S2/E2 - The Tomb Of King Herod'. This episode looks at the Bible's most notorious villain, King Herod, and investigates whether his fearsome reputation is deserved.

programme.title: Lost Grail With Alice Roberts

programme.title: Gold Wars Downunder
